inherited_route_boundary.reference: R03 contains the prior representative routes C7 through C14 and the R01 paper benchmark.
inherited_route_boundary.current_meaning: The earlier negative or not-testable results remain bounded route findings. They do not establish that every future domestic product or strategy fails.

open_universe_governance: The research universe is open; it is not limited to ETFs or the products already tested.

Direct mainland equities are not excluded. A Shanghai/Shenzhen A-share scope and any separate BSE coverage must be explicitly frozen; every future included stock requires full equity-research diligence before it can enter a paper rule.

A fixed rulebook cannot silently add a product after its protocol is frozen. A distinct candidate must state its economic hypothesis, universe, product diligence, data source, accounting, implementation limits and independent-review plan before calculation.
No product becomes an action target through a favourable name, headline yield, full-period average or backfilled proxy.
The current case does not claim that a 5% result is guaranteed for any year, holding period, market state or individual.

next_research_queue.next_gate: C19/C22 identify conditional multi-source paths only. Obtain written rights, field dictionaries, samples and full point-in-time coverage for valuation, market, realized-event and universe fields, then independently verify that ordinary-investor eligibility can be established bond by bond and date by date.

C21 identifies conditional SSE/SZSE licensed-data routes only. Obtain and hash the point-in-time public-REIT universe, auditable price/NAV/distribution/corporate-action history, dated cost and execution records, and non-sensitive eligibility evidence before defining a product-neutral protocol.

Complete C23-GATE-1: written data rights, a point-in-time product/share-class sample including inactive funds, total-return/event and historical fee/status fields, and independent reconciliation to primary disclosures before a rule design.

Obtain written historical-data rights and a point-in-time market/universe/event package for the declared stock scope, then complete full equity-research diligence and independent reconstruction for every future included stock before a rule design.
May be proposed only through a new pre-calculation protocol and product-level diligence; it may not alter C16 or C17 after their results.

strict_research_gate.five_percent_role: Long-run research hurdle only, not a guarantee or forecast.
requirements_before_any_higher_status: Every source-covered calendar year and every eligible rolling-five-calendar-year endpoint must meet the frozen threshold after the defined cost and cash-flow treatment.
Actual product, access, quote, liquidity, settlement, fee, tax, no-fill and risk-event evidence must be retained.
An independent reconstruction and a forward paper observation record must pass without rule changes.
